title: Knowledge check: Error Propagation with next(err)

questions.prompt: In Error Propagation with next(err), which statement best describes Passing errors to Express?
options: Normalize expected failures into safe, predictable responses and forward unexpected failures to the final error handler. Keep diagnostic details in protected logs, not public responses.
Middleware runs in registered order. Each function must end the response, call next() to continue, or forward an error; avoid accidentally doing more than one of these.
Move all backend decisions into the browser and trust the submitted values.
Return the same success response for every request regardless of outcome.
questions.answer_key: Normalize expected failures into safe, predictable responses and forward unexpected failures to the final error handler. Keep diagnostic details in protected logs, not public responses.
questions.explanation: Normalize expected failures into safe, predictable responses and forward unexpected failures to the final error handler. Keep diagnostic details in protected logs, not public responses.
